definitions.first_detection_step: earliest zero-based event index whose ingest (or the end_episode finalize pass) emitted this trigger; repeated firings never replace it
definitions.latency_scope: latency statistics cover only expected-trigger hits on episodes with a recorded onset; cross-firing timings are in the per-episode first_detection map instead
definitions.onset_step: zero-based index of the first event at which the fixture generator intentionally introduces the labeled failure condition; null when the generator cannot derive one
definitions.tn: one-vs-rest: the episode does not expect this trigger and the trigger does not fire; TP+FP+TN+FN equals the episode count

seeds.scope: all 170 labeled records and healthy-41..59; omitted on the 41 legacy controls to keep their bytes unchanged
